title: MEIKO — Looking For Answers〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after the STANDOUT show
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, you messed up the same part again. One more time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! Let me try again!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you were a little off too, Saki. Listen to where everyone else is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay. Got it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, you need to drum like you mean it a little more. Otherwise, we won't be able to hold it together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, once more.
Honami, count us in...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Their sound is getting more and more powerful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're right. You can tell how serious they are about this just by looking at them too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're just gonna keep getting better and better from here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Going pro won't be easy for them, but I'm sure they'll find a way to succeed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Pros, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright! That means we'll need to give them the best support possible too...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you two looking at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Compared to before, you seem completely different now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can say since I'm not a professional myself...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But maybe it has something to do with constantly trying to understand what your music is about...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, there has to be more to it than that! What about having to push the other things you want to do to the side and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not even Miku can answer this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. I've never thought about going pro or how to do it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have to think that you had more to say then, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-What could you possibly be talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? You seemed so anxious after that too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yes, MEIKO, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I kept wondering if there's anything else I can do for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I knew it! But it didn't seem like you regretted saying that or anything...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was wondering about what I should say if I were asked the same thing again...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I see. That's why you've been trying to find somewhere to be alone. You were practicing your little speech.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?! Y-You knew about that too?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sorry, we happened to see you in the middle of your rehearsal when we went looking for you the other day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry that you weren't able to put it to use...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, it's better that Ichika and the others were able to come up with an answer on their own.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
True.
I'm so proud of them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But things may get pretty rough from here on out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They'll probably have to overcome quite a few obstacles in order to make their dream come true.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm sure they'll be able to.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why we need to keep supporting them as much as possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Of course!
